notes: Roden Law statistics registry, seeded from docs/stat-audit-2026-08-25.md, stat-audit-round2 and round4. Every value traces to a primary source with a vintage. The law (statutes, caps, deadlines) is NOT here — it lives in internal-ai-scripts/law/<STATE>.json.
